proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X a b hX
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_add_const (hX.1.const_mul a) b]
  exact ProbabilityTheory.variance_const_mul a X μ
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ → ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun ω => a * X ω + b) μ = a ^ 2 * ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ
